summary: Overland Advantage filed an 8-K reporting a Fourth Amendment to its Revolving Credit Facility. The amendment extends the revolving period to July 2, 2028 and maturity to July 2, 2030; reduces interest rates by 40 bps during and after the revolving period; lowers the unused fee from 0.50% to 0.40%; increases a liquidity covenant from $25M to $30M; and raises concentration limits for Second Lien/FLLO Loans from 15% to 25%. This is a routine credit agreement modification with no change in control, no acquisition or divestiture, and no special-situation event.
